summary.intent: Debug and fix a stale file content issue where the FUSE-mounted folder showed the original version of a file after it had been edited and saved via the web UI.
summary.outcome: Root cause identified in `populate_folder()` in `crates/fuse/src/inode.rs` — already-resolved inodes were never re-fetched even when `modified_at` changed. Fix applied, tested (37 tests pass), pushed to `fix/` branch, PR #454 created, and all 4 CodeRabbit review comments addressed and resolved.

repo: FUSE mount folder metadata refreshes every 30s via TTL expiry; `drain_refresh_completions` calls `populate_folder` with new metadata after each refresh cycle.
Content cache is keyed by CID (content-addressed), so it correctly returns different data for different CIDs — stale content bugs are upstream in the inode CID reference, not in the cache itself.
IPNS private key and encrypted key hex are stable across file edits; only the CID changes when a file is edited, so these fields can be preserved when marking a file for re-resolution.
The project uses a `gsd-debugger` subagent pattern for investigations to keep main context lean — debug sessions are persisted to `.planning/debug/*.md`.
Cargo.lock diffs can include phantom version bumps for packages whose `Cargo.toml` was not actually changed; these should be reverted before committing.
The monorepo recently added a full landing page (`landing/`) built with Astro, a `render.yaml` for deployment, and a GitHub Actions deploy workflow for the landing site.

code.finding: `populate_folder()` preserved the existing `InodeKind` wholesale for resolved files (`file_meta_resolved: true`), never comparing `modified_at` timestamps, so updated IPNS records were never re-fetched after a web UI edit.

Fix: when a `FilePointer`'s `modified_at` is newer than the existing inode's `mtime`, the file is reset to `file_meta_resolved: false` with CID/key/iv cleared but IPNS name and keys preserved, triggering a fresh IPNS resolution on the next `drain_refresh_completions` cycle.

PR review fixes included: renaming `_resolved` to `was_resolved` for clarity, falling back to the FilePointer's IPNS name when the existing inode has none, handling FilePointer identity changes by comparing IPNS names, and extending tests to cover IPNS key preservation and identity-change scenarios.

workflow: The gsd-debugger subagent pattern is effective for context-heavy investigations: each agent gets a fresh 200k context window, with state persisted to a debug markdown file for continuations.
When CodeRabbit review threads are open, they can be fetched via GitHub GraphQL `reviewThreads` query and resolved programmatically via `resolveReviewThread` mutation after fixing.
Replying to PR review comments via REST requires `--field in_reply_to=COMMENT_ID` (integer) rather than `-f`, and resolve is done separately via GraphQL mutation.

friction: Cargo.lock picked up a spurious version bump for `cipherbox-fuse` that had to be manually reverted before committing — phantom lock file noise can obscure real diffs.
The debug session planning file was not included in the initial PR commit and required a follow-up commit after the user prompted for it.
open_items: The fix relies on `modified_at` timestamp propagation being accurate; if clock skew or timestamp precision issues exist between the web UI and FUSE layer, re-resolution may not trigger correctly.
The ~30-60s wait (one or two TTL cycles) before the mounted file updates is a known latency — no work was done to reduce this or make it configurable.
No E2E test covers the full upload → web-edit → FUSE-read round-trip; verification was manual.
